A simple professional process

Read deeply. Revise deliberately.

Good feedback is not a verdict. It is material you can examine, question, and use. This desk keeps the reader's response beside the words it is responding to.

01

Capture the manuscript

Import a text file or paste your chapters. The desk keeps an original draft and a separate improved version.

02

Organize the response

Record feedback under consistent lenses so patterns become visible across chapters.

03

Make the changes

Use the revision brief as a guide, then edit the improved version in your own voice.

04

Take your work with you

Download feedback and revised manuscript files separately, either as a whole book or by chapter.

A note on privacy

Your draft is not a product.

This app is designed to work without an account or a manuscript server. Your project lives in this browser until you export it. Clear your browser data and the local project may be lost, so use Backup project regularly.
